w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Callback is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

🍖 FEASTED ×2.53 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Arc IV burns hotter. Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. Déjà vu with teeth. Someone at the haven should hear about this.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Loud-Eyes." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
You camp wild tonight — no hall meal, but the pantry still reaches you through System requisition. Eat from your pack tonight.

w5Mentions.name: The Network Note
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Network Note.
firstContext: 💛 You hold Knife roll. The dinner rush, the pass, the tickets coming faster than thought. You survived your first Saturday service at sixteen. The roll was the prize. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they have carried you this far. The feast was the weapon.
Something moves out there — The Network Note.
👁️ Desmond freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Omar: "Huh. Never been this way before."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (22/13/6), with 7 wave-4 and 1 wave-5 fought, 9 contests survived, 5 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 27 → 24 · capped · Craft 12 · Talk 17 · Explore 35 → 24 · capped)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TOTAL — COLD, CLEAN, EFFICIENT. YOU WOULD MAKE A MAGNIFICENT MACHINE. I MEAN THAT AS THE HIGHEST COMPLIMENT AND SLIGHTLY AS A THREAT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept; the relay carried faithfully. The dark road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ Henrik Lien reached into the light and the light reached back — person and machine, two caretakers, holding the channel open between them both ways. The village endures, and the conversation does not end.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
